verses.geez: እፌንዎሙ፡ ከመ፡ አራዊት፡ ውስተ፡ ምድረ፡ ኰኵሕ።
verses.translation: I will send as it were reptiles on the land: is not the mount of the daughter of Sion a desolate rock?

translations.lxx: I will send as it were reptiles on the land: is not the mount of the daughter of Sion a desolate rock?
translations.kjv: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
translations.ron: "Trimiteţi miei stăpânitorului ţării, trimiteţi-i din Petra, prin pustiu, la muntele fiicei Sionului".
translations.grk: Ἀποστέλω ὡς ἑρπετὰ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν· μὴ πέτρα ἔρημός ἐστι τὸ ὄρος θυγατρὸς Σιών;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኮንኪ፡ ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ እንተ፡ አስረረት፡ እጐሊሃ፡ ወኀደገት፤ ወኮንኪ፡ ወለተ፡ ሞአብ፤ ከመ፡ መሐስአ፡ አባግዕ፡ ስቡሕ።
verses.translation: For thou shalt be as a young bird taken away from a bird that has flown: even thou shalt be so, daughter of Moab: and then do thou, O Arnon,

translations.lxx: For thou shalt be as a young bird taken away from a bird that has flown: even thou shalt be so, daughter of Moab: and then do thou, O Arnon,
translations.kjv: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
translations.ron: Ca o pasăre care fuge sperioasă din cuibul ei, ca un cuib risipit, aşa sunt fiicele Moabului la vadurile Arnonului.
translations.grk: Ἔσῃ γὰρ ὡς πετεινοῦ ἀνιπταμένου νοσσὸς ἀφῃρημένος, ἔσῃ θυγάτηρ Μωὰβ, ἔπειτα δέ Ἀρνῶν πλείονα

verses.geez: ወትመክር፡ ብዙኀ፡ አርኖን፡ ከመ፡ ትግበር፡ ላቲ፡ ዳሰ፡ ኀበ፡ ትነብር፡ ውስተ፡ ምስሐግ፡ ወትረ፣፡ መዓልተ፡ ወሌሊተ፡ ይደነግፁ፡ ወይሜምዑ።
verses.translation: take farther counsel, and continually make thou a shelter from grief: they flee in darkness at mid-day; they are amazed; be not thou led captive.

translations.lxx: take farther counsel, and continually make thou a shelter from grief: they flee in darkness at mid-day; they are amazed; be not thou led captive.
translations.kjv: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
translations.ron: "Dă un sfat, dă o hotărâre, întinde umbra ta, ca noaptea, în miezul zilei, ascunde pe cei duşi în robie, nu descoperi pe cei fugari!
translations.grk: βουλεύου, ποίει τε σκέπην πένθους αὕτη διαπαντὸς, ἐν μεσημβρινῇ σκοτίᾳ φεύγουσιν, ἐξέστησαν· μὴ ἀχθῇς,

verses.geez: ወኢታንብሮሙ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ለእለ፡ ወተጉ፡ እምነ፡ ሞአብ፡ ከመ፡ ይኩኑክሙ፡ ሐፁረክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ገጸ፡ እለ፡ ሮዱክሙ፤ እስመ፡ ኀልቁ፡ መስተቃትላን፡ ወተሐጕለ፡ መልአክ፡ ዘላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: The fugitives of Moab shall sojourn with thee; they shall be to you a shelter from the face of the pursuer: for thine alliance has been taken away, and the oppressing ruler has perished from off the earth.

translations.lxx: The fugitives of Moab shall sojourn with thee; they shall be to you a shelter from the face of the pursuer: for thine alliance has been taken away, and the oppressing ruler has perished from off the earth.
translations.kjv: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
translations.ron: Adăposteşte la tine pe toţi robii Moabului, să le fii acoperitor în faţa pustiitorului, până când năvala va fi trecut, prăpădul va lua sfârşit şi vrăjmaşul va lăsa tara în pace.
translations.grk: παροικήσουσί σοι οἱ φυγάδες Μωάβ· ἔσονται σκέπη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ προσώπου διώκοντος, ὅτι ἤρθη ἡ συμμαχία σου, καὶ ὁ ἄρχων ἀπώλετο ὁ καταπατῶν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez: ወይረትዕ፡ መንበሩ፡ በምጽዋት፡ ወይነብር፡ ውስቴቱ፡ በጽድቅ፣፡ ወይኴንን፡ በቤተ፡ ዳዊት፡ ወየኀሥሥ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወይዴግን፡ ጽድቀ።
verses.translation: And a throne shall be established with mercy; and one shall sit upon it with truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and earnestly seeking judgments, and hasting righteousness.

translations.lxx: And a throne shall be established with mercy; and one shall sit upon it with truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and earnestly seeking judgments, and hasting righteousness.
translations.kjv: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
translations.ron: Jilţul lui se va întări prin milostivire şi pe el va şedea de-a pururi în cortul lui David un judecător apărător al pricinei drepte şi râvnitor dreptăţii.
translations.grk: Καὶ διορθωθήσεται μετʼ ἐλέους θρόνος, καὶ καθιεῖται ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ μετὰ ἀληθείας ἐν σκηνῇ Δαυὶδ, κρίνων καὶ ἐκζητῶν κρίμα καὶ σπεύδων δικαιοσύνην.

verses.geez: ሰማዕነ፡ ትዕቢተ፡ ሞአብ፡ ወጽዕለተ፡ ፈድፋደ፣፡ ወአእተትኩ፡ ትዕቢተ።
verses.translation: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud. I have cut off his pride: thy prophecy shall not be thus, no not thus.

translations.lxx: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud. I have cut off his pride: thy prophecy shall not be thus, no not thus.
translations.kjv: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
translations.ron: Am auzit de semeţia Moabului, că foarte mândru este; am auzit de obrăznicia, de mândria, de trufia şi de graiurile lui deşarte".
translations.grk: Ἠκούσαμεν τὴν ὕβριν Μωὰβ, ὑβριστὴς σφόδρα τὴν ὑπερηφανίαν ἐξῇρα· οὐχ οὕτως ἡ μαντεία σου, οὐχ οὕτως.

verses.geez: ወውዑ፡ ሞአብ፡ እስመ፡ በሞአብ፡ አውየዉ፡ ኵሎሙ፤ እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ዴሴም፡ ይስሕጡ፡ ወኢይትኀፈሩ።
verses.translation: Moab shall howl; for all shall howl in the land of Moab: but thou shalt care for them that dwell in Seth, and thou shalt not be ashamed.

translations.lxx: Moab shall howl; for all shall howl in the land of Moab: but thou shalt care for them that dwell in Seth, and thou shalt not be ashamed.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta, Moabiţii se tânguiesc pentru Moab, ton împreună se bocesc! Ei suspină pentru turtele de struguri de la Chir-Hareset, înmărmuriţi.
translations.grk: Ὀλολύξει Μωὰβ, ἐν γὰρ τῇ Μωαβίτιδι πάντες ὀλολύξουσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσι δέ Σεθ μελετήσεις, καὶ οὐκ ἐντραπήσῃ.

verses.translation: The plains of Esebon shall mourn, the vine of Sebama: swallowing up the nations, trample ye her vines, even to Jazer: ye shall not come together; wander ye in the desert: they that were sent are deserted, for they have gone over to the sea.

translations.lxx: The plains of Esebon shall mourn, the vine of Sebama: swallowing up the nations, trample ye her vines, even to Jazer: ye shall not come together; wander ye in the desert: they that were sent are deserted, for they have gone over to the sea.
translations.kjv: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
translations.ron: Câmpiile Heşbonului au sărăcit, asemenea şi via de la Sibma; stăpânitorul popoarelor a distrus cele mai bune viţe ale ei, care se întinseseră până la Iazer şi acoperiseră pustiul; lăstarii lor se întinseseră şi trecuseră marea.
translations.grk: Τὰ πεδία Ἑσεβὼν πενθήσει, ἄμπελος Σεβαμά· καταπίνοντες τὰ ἔθνη, καταπατήστε τὰς ἀμπέλους αὐτῆς, ἕως Ἰαζήρ· οὐ μὴ συνάψητε, πλανήθητε τὴν ἔρημον, οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι ἐνκατελείφθησαν, διέβησαν γὰρ πρὸς τὴν θάλασσαν.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ እበኪ፡ ከመ፡ ብካየ፡ ኢያዜር፡ ወይነ፡ ሴባማ።
verses.translation: Therefore will I weep as with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sebama; Esebon and Eleale have cast down thy trees; for I will trample on thy harvest and on thy vintages, and all thy plants shall fall.

translations.lxx: Therefore will I weep as with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sebama; Esebon and Eleale have cast down thy trees; for I will trample on thy harvest and on thy vintages, and all thy plants shall fall.
translations.kjv: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta plâng împreună cu Iazerul pentru via din Sibma. Vă ud cu lacrimile mele pe voi, Heşbon şi Eleale, că nu se mai aud acolo strigătele vesele din timpul secerişului şi al culesului viilor.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο κλαύσομαι ὡς τὸν κλαυθμὸν Ἰαζὴρ ἄμπελον Σεβαμά· τὰ δένδρα σου κατέβαλεν Ἐσεβὼν καὶ Ἐλεαλὴ, ὅτι ἐπὶ τῷ θερισμῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ τρυγητῷ σου καταπατήσω, καὶ πάντα πεσοῦνται.

verses.geez: ወእሥዕር፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ወኃሴተ፡ እምወይን፡ ወኢይትፌሥሑ፡ እንከ፡ በወይን፡ ወኢያከይዱ፡ ወይነ፡ ውስተ፡ ምክያድ፡ እስመ፡ ጠፍአ።
verses.translation: And gladness and rejoicing shall be taken away from the vineyards; and they shall not rejoice at all in thy vineyards; and they shall not at all tread wine into the vats; for the vintage has ceased.

translations.lxx: And gladness and rejoicing shall be taken away from the vineyards; and they shall not rejoice at all in thy vineyards; and they shall not at all tread wine into the vats; for the vintage has ceased.
translations.kjv: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
translations.ron: Nici bucurie, nici veselie prin grădini, iar prin vii nici cântece, nici chiote! Nimeni nu mai dă vinul la teasc, strigătul călcătorului a încetat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀρθήσεται εὐφροσύνη καὶ ἀγαλλίαμα ἐκ τῶν ἀμπελώνων, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀμπελῶσί σου οὐ μὴ εὐφρανθήσονται, καὶ οὐ μὴ πατήσουσιν οἶνον εἰς τὰ ὑπολήνια, πέπαυται γάρ.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ትነቁ፡ ከርሥየ፡ ከመ፡ መሰንቆ፡ በእንተ፡ ሞአብ፡ ወአዕፅምትየ፡ ከመ፡ አረፍት፡ እንተ፡ ገየሩ።
verses.translation: Therefore my belly shall sound as a harp for Moab, and thou hast repaired my inward parts as a wall.

translations.lxx: Therefore my belly shall sound as a harp for Moab, and thou hast repaired my inward parts as a wall.
translations.kjv: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta lăuntrul meu se zbuciumă pentru Moab ca o harfă şi inima mea pentru Chir-Hares.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ἡ κοιλία μου ἐπὶ Μωὰβ ὡς κιθάρα ἠχήσει, καὶ τὰ ἐντός μου ὡς τεῖχος ἐνεκαίνισας.

verses.geez: ወይከውነከ፡ ለኃሣር፡ እስመ፡ ሰርሐት፡ ሞአብ፡ በጣዖታ፡ ወተሐውር፡ ኀበ፡ አማልክቲሃ፡ ትጸሊ፣፡ ወኢይክሉ፡ እንከ፡ አድኅኖታ።
verses.translation: And it shall be to thy shame, (for Moab is wearied at the altars,) that he shall go in to the idols thereof to pray, but they shall not be at all able to deliver him.

translations.lxx: And it shall be to thy shame, (for Moab is wearied at the altars,) that he shall go in to the idols thereof to pray, but they shall not be at all able to deliver him.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
translations.ron: Iată că Moabul este văzut urcând obosit pe locurile înalte, intră în templul său să se roage, dar nu dobândeşte nimic.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται εἰς τὸ ἐντραπῆναί σε, ὅτι ἐκοπίασε Μωὰβ ἐπὶ τοῖς βωμοῖς, καὶ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὰ χειροποίητα αὐτῆς, ὥστε προσεύξασθαι, καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνηται ἐξελέσθαι αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ዝንቱ፡ ነገር፡ ዘነበበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ ሞአብ፣፡ ዘነበበ፡ ቀዲሙ።
verses.translation: This is the word which the Lord spoke against Moab, when he spoke.

translations.lxx: This is the word which the Lord spoke against Moab, when he spoke.
translations.kjv: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
translations.ron: Aceasta este proorocia pe care a grăit-o Domnul odinioară pentru Moab.
translations.grk: Τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησε Κύριος ἐπὶ Μωὰβ, ὁπότε ἐλάλησε.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ እብል፤ ዘሠለስቱ፡ ዓመተ፡ ዓሳብ፡ የኀሥር፡ ክብረ፡ ሞአብ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ብዕላ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ወኢትተርፍ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ ወኢትረክብ፡ እንከ፡ ክብራ።
verses.translation: And now I say, In three years, of the years of an hireling, the glory of Moab shall be dishonoured with all his great wealth; and he shall be left few in number, and not honoured.

translations.lxx: And now I say, In three years, of the years of an hireling, the glory of Moab shall be dishonoured with all his great wealth; and he shall be left few in number, and not honoured.
translations.kjv: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
translations.ron: Iar acum Domnul a zis aşa: "Peste trei ani, socotiţi ca anii unui simbriaş, mărirea Moabului se va micşora cu vuiet mare şi va rămâne mică şi slabă, fără nici o putere".
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν λέγῳ, ἐν τρισὶν ἔτεσιν ἐτῶν μισθωτοῦ ἀτιμασθήσεται ἡ δόξα Μωὰβ παντὶ τῷ πλούτῳ τῷ πολλῷ, καὶ καταλειφθήσεται ὀλιγοστὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἔντιμος. ΤΟ ῬΗΜΑ ΤΟ ΚΑΤΑ ΔΑΜΑΣΚΟΥ.
